It is often used to refer to the initial period of Islamic history, covering the life of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and the rise of the Islamic state in Medina. This era is also known as the "Bidayah period," and it is marked by the development of Islamic laws, social structures, and political organization.

The spiritual journey towards Allah is seen as a continuous process, starting from the very beginning, or Bidayah. In the Islamic context, the Bidayah period can be seen as the foundational stage of this spiritual journey, where Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) received God's revelations and established the foundations of the Islamic way of life. This period marked the beginning of a journey towards living a God-conscious life, fuelled by the pursuit of nearness to Allah, compassion for all of God's creation, and following the teachings of the Prophet.
